title: Kim Jong Un tours North Korea ski resort with daughter Ju Ae
html:
Kim Jong Un tours North Korea ski resort with daughter Ju Ae

Kim Jong Un toured a ski resort under development in a tourist district in Samjiyon with his daughter Ju Ae, amid speculation over a potential meeting with US President Donald Trump in China.
summary: Kim Jong Un toured a ski resort under development in a tourist district in Samjiyon with his daughter Ju Ae.
